name: ts_apikey_list
title: List WebQuery API keys
description: Lists the WebQuery API keys of every query login: id, owner, virtual server, scope (read, write or manage), and when each expires. The secret key values are never shown; the server does not reveal them after creation.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_ban_list
title: List bans
description: Lists the active ban rules of a virtual server: what each matches (IP address, name pattern, unique identity or myTeamSpeak id), the reason, who created it and when, when it expires, and how often it has been enforced.

limit.description: How many bans to return, from 1 to 200.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_channel_find
title: Find channels by name
description: Finds the channels whose name contains some text, ignoring case, and returns their ids and full names.

pattern.description: Text to find in channel names, for example 'afk'.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_channel_info
title: Show a channel
description: Shows every property of one channel: name, topic, description, codec, limits, needed talk power, flags and the rest of its configuration, by their ServerQuery field names.

channelId.description: The channel id, as listed by ts_channel_list.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_channel_list
title: List channels
description: Lists the channels of a virtual server in the order TeamSpeak clients display them, with topic, client counts, slot limit and whether each is the default, password-protected, permanent, semi-permanent or temporary. Set tree to true to nest sub-channels under their parents instead of a flat list with parent ids.

tree.description: Nest sub-channels under their parents. Defaults to a flat list in display order.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_channelgroup_list
title: List channel groups
description: Lists the channel groups of a virtual server with their id, name, kind (regular, template or query), icon, sort order and the powers needed to modify the group or add and remove its members.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_channelgroup_members
title: List channel group assignments
description: Lists which client holds which channel group in which channel. Filter by any combination of channelId, databaseId and groupId. Clients who only have the default channel group are not stored as assignments and do not appear.

databaseId.description: Only assignments of this client database id.

groupId.description: Only assignments of this channel group.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_client_find
title: Find online clients by nickname
description: Finds the currently connected clients whose nickname contains some text and returns their session ids and nicknames. To find someone who is offline, use ts_clientdb_find.

pattern.description: Text to find in nicknames, for example 'alice'.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_client_groups
title: Show a client's groups
description: Shows every group one client identity belongs to, online or not: its server groups by id and name, and the channel groups it holds in particular channels.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_client_info
title: Show an online client
description: Shows every property of one connected client: version, platform, country, connection time, idle time, groups, talk power, mute state and the rest, by their ServerQuery field names. Takes the session client id from ts_client_list, which changes on every reconnect, not the permanent database id.

clientId.description: The client's session id (clientId in ts_client_list), not its database id.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_client_list
title: List online clients
description: Lists the clients currently connected to a virtual server: nickname, the channel they are in, their session client id and permanent database id, unique identity, server groups, channel group and away status. Query clients, including this MCP server's own session, are left out unless includeQueryClients is true.

includeQueryClients.description: Include ServerQuery clients such as bots and this MCP server's own session.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_client_resolve
title: Resolve a client identity
description: Resolves any one of the ids TeamSpeak uses for a client into all of them: the permanent database id (what permissions and groups use), the unique identity, the last nickname, and the session ids of any current connections (what moving, kicking and messaging use). Pass exactly one of clientId, databaseId or uniqueId. To search by nickname, use ts_clientdb_find.

clientId.description: A session id of a connected client, as in ts_client_list.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_clientdb_find
title: Find known client identities
description: Finds client identities a virtual server knows, online or not, by last nickname or by unique identity, and returns each with its database id, unique identity, nickname and any online session ids. Plain text matches anywhere in the nickname; % works as a wildcard. At most 10 matches are resolved in full; totalMatches says how many there were.

pattern.description: Text to find, for example 'alice'. Use % as a wildcard; plain text matches anywhere.

byUniqueId.description: Search unique identities instead of nicknames.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_clientdb_info
title: Show a known client identity
description: Shows everything a virtual server stores about one client identity, online or not: unique identity, nicknames, creation and last connection, connection count, traffic totals, avatar and description, by their ServerQuery field names.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_clientdb_list
title: List known client identities
description: Pages through every client identity a virtual server has ever seen, online or not: database id, unique identity, last nickname, when it was created and last connected, how often it connected, and its last IP address. Page with offset and limit; total says how many identities exist.

limit.description: How many identities to return, from 1 to 200.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_complaint_list
title: List complaints
description: Lists the complaints users filed against other users on a virtual server: who complained about whom, the message, and when. Pass databaseId to see only complaints about one client.

databaseId.description: Only complaints about this client database id.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_custom_info
title: Show a client's custom properties
description: Lists the custom properties stored for one client identity, such as a linked forum account, as identifier and value pairs. Integrations set these; most clients have none.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_custom_search
title: Find clients by custom property
description: Finds the client identities whose custom property has a given value, for example which client is linked to a forum account. Plain text matches anywhere in the value; % works as a wildcard.

pattern.description: The value to find. Use % as a wildcard; plain text matches anywhere.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_health_report
title: Check a virtual server's health
description: Checks how a virtual server is doing: status, uptime, people and query clients online against the slot limit, channel count, packet loss, average ping and bandwidth, plus findings in plain words for anything that deserves attention, such as slots running out, packet loss or high ping.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_instance_info
title: Show the server instance
description: Summarises a TeamSpeak server instance in one call: the server version and platform, uptime and totals across all virtual servers, instance-wide settings such as the file transfer port and query flood limits, and the IP addresses it listens on.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_log_view
title: Read the server log
description: Reads the most recent entries of a virtual server's log, or of the instance log, oldest first: timestamp, level, source and message. Connections, kicks, bans, permission and group changes and query activity all appear here. For older entries, pass the previous page's position back as beforePosition.

lines.description: How many entries to return, from 1 to 100.

instance.description: Read the instance log instead of the virtual server's.

beforePosition.description: The position a previous page reported, to read the entries before it.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_message_get
title: Read an offline message
description: Reads one offline message from this MCP server's own query login inbox, including its body. Reading it does not mark it as read.

messageId.description: The message id, as listed by ts_message_list.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_message_list
title: List offline messages
description: Lists the offline messages in this MCP server's own query login inbox: sender, subject, when it arrived and whether it was read. Use ts_message_get for a body.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_perm_assigned
title: List assigned permissions
description: Lists the permissions assigned directly to one target, with name, value and the negate and skip flags. Pass exactly one target: serverGroupId, channelGroupId, channelId alone (channel permissions, mostly the powers needed to join or talk), databaseId alone (permissions on a client identity), or channelId together with databaseId (a client's permissions in one channel). To see what a client ends up with from all of these combined, use ts_perm_effective.

channelId.description: A channel id; with databaseId, the channel of a channel-client pair.

databaseId.description: A client database id; with channelId, the client of a channel-client pair.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_perm_effective
title: Explain a client's effective permissions
description: Answers 'why can or can't this client do X?'. For one client identity in one channel, shows the value the client ends up with for a permission and every assignment that fed into it: each server group, the client itself, its channel group in that channel and any client-in-channel permission, marking which one decided and whether a skip flag kept the channel layers out. Pass permission for an exact name, or search for text in names such as 'kick'. Without channelId it uses the channel the client is in, or the default channel when the client is offline. Channel permissions such as the power needed to join are listed as requirements, not grants.

databaseId.description: The client's database id; see ts_client_resolve.

permission.description: An exact permission name, for example 'i_client_talk_power'.

search.description: Text to find in permission names instead, for example 'kick'.

channelId.description: The channel to evaluate in. Defaults to the client's current channel, or the default channel when offline.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_perm_find
title: Find where a permission is assigned
description: Finds every place one permission is assigned on a virtual server: which server groups, channel groups, channels, clients and client-in-channel pairs carry it, with group names. Use it to answer 'who can kick people here?'.

permission.description: The permission name, for example 'i_client_kick_from_server_power'. See ts_perm_list.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

annotations.title: Find where a permission is assigned

name: ts_perm_list
title: Search permissions
description: Searches the permissions a TeamSpeak server knows by name or description, for example 'talk' or 'kick', returning id, name and description. Use it to find the exact name other permission tools need. Without search it returns the first permissions by id; totalMatches says how many matched.

search.description: Text to find in permission names and descriptions, for example 'talk_power'.

limit.description: How many permissions to return, from 1 to 200.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_profiles_list
title: List TeamSpeak profiles
description: Lists the TeamSpeak servers this MCP server is configured to administer, with the interface and safety level each uses. Does not contact any server. Call this first when several profiles exist and a tool needs a profile name.

name: ts_query_raw
title: Send a raw ServerQuery command
description: Sends one TeamSpeak ServerQuery command that no dedicated tool covers, and returns the records it produces. Prefer a dedicated tool whenever one exists. The command needs the safety level of what it does: read commands need ReadOnly, changes need Write, and deleting, banning, kicking or handing out access needs Destructive, as does any command this server does not classify. Session commands (use, login, logout, quit, servernotifyregister, servernotifyunregister) are refused because the connection is shared.

command.description: The command name alone, for example 'clientdbfind'. Parameters and options go in their own arguments.

parameters.description: Key/value parameters, for example {"pattern": "Alice"}. Values are escaped automatically.

options.description: Flag options, for example ["-uid"]. The leading dash is optional.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_querylogin_list
title: List query logins
description: Lists the ServerQuery logins created for a virtual server, such as those of bots and integrations, with the client database id each belongs to. The built-in serveradmin login is not listed.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_servergroup_list
title: List server groups
description: Lists the server groups of a virtual server with their id, name, kind (regular, template or query), icon, sort order and the powers needed to modify the group or add and remove its members.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_servergroup_members
title: List server group members
description: Lists the client identities in one server group, online or not, with database id, last nickname and unique identity.

groupId.description: The server group id, as listed by ts_servergroup_list.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_token_list
title: List privilege keys
description: Lists the unused privilege keys of a virtual server: the key itself, the server group or channel group it grants, when it was created and its description. The keys are live credentials, so this needs the Write safety level even though it changes nothing.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_vserver_info
title: Show a virtual server
description: Shows every property of one virtual server: name, welcome message, slots, uptime, packet loss and ping totals, security level, default groups, and the rest of its configuration, by their ServerQuery field names.

virtualServerId.description: The virtual server to address, as listed by ts_vserver_list. Omit it to use the profile's default virtual server.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_vserver_list
title: List virtual servers
description: Lists the virtual servers on a TeamSpeak instance with their id, port, status, name and how many clients are online. The id is what other tools take as virtualServerId.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.

name: ts_whoami
title: Show the query session identity
description: Shows who this MCP server is logged in as on a TeamSpeak server: the query login, its client and database ids, and the virtual server its session currently has selected. Useful for checking that a profile connects and with which account.

profile.description: The configured TeamSpeak server to use, as listed by ts_profiles_list. Omit it when only one profile is configured.
